items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: He had his brother, Joe, and a drummer

ctx.x: We left there and we went to Chicago to play a place called the Capital Lounge down on State Street. That was like just a paradise for a musician to be in, because at that particular time it seemed like everybody was in Chicago... There were names all over the place. We were at the Capital Lounge along with Muggsy Spanier's group, and the first time I'd ever... I'd heard about Muggsy Spanier, but I'd never met him. He was a very fine old man. He used to talk to us a lot, and he loved to come down in the dressing…
Then round the corner, Roy Eldridge had a band at a place called the Preview. He had his brother, Joe, and a drummer
